name: DefectDojo
description: Imports findings from an open-source DefectDojo instance (https://github.com/DefectDojo/django-DefectDojo), e.g. the AWS GovCloud deployment produced by the DefectDojo Pro IaC Studio (ESP09/vuln-mgmt-comp1-IaC). Each DefectDojo Product (software) becomes an ASSET tagged with its Product Type (platform); each finding becomes a vulnerability mapped by its canonical CVE (CVE > ZDAY > GHSA), with severity, CVSS v3, EPSS and CISA KEV flags preserved, and affected components recorded. Live mode: read-only GET /api/v2/findings/ (paginated, related_fields) with an API token from the DD_API_TOKEN worker env; HTTPS only with full TLS verification (SSL_CERT_FILE / REQUESTS_CA_BUNDLE for an internal CA) and the standard HTTPS_PROXY / NO_PROXY variables. Offline mode: parse a saved findings JSON export. Duplicates, false positives and out-of-scope findings are skipped. Stdlib only; no DB access in run.py (worker-safe).

parameters.name: url
parameters.help: DefectDojo base URL, e.g. https://dojo.example.gov (or DD_URL in the worker env). HTTPS only.

parameters.name: file
parameters.help: Offline mode: a saved findings export (GET /api/v2/findings/?related_fields=true JSON, a single page or a list of findings).

parameters.name: product
parameters.help: Only import findings of this DefectDojo Product (software) name.

parameters.name: include_mitigated
parameters.help: Also import mitigated/inactive findings (default: active only).

parameters.name: min_severity
parameters.help: Minimum severity to import: Critical, High, Medium, Low or Info.

parameters.name: limit
parameters.help: Maximum number of findings to read in live mode.
